stemMd: A linear function has $f(0)=12$ and $f(5)=32$. What is $f(8)$?
explanationMd: The slope is (32−12)/5=4, so f(x)=4x+12. Thus f(8)=32+12=44. A three-unit move from x=5 adds 12.

distractorRationale.a: This does not include the correct initial value with the slope.
distractorRationale.c: This incorrectly treats the increase over five units as a larger per-unit rate.
distractorRationale.d: This doubles f(5) rather than using the linear relationship.
